Both were for Christ-centred community events in 2026. The same process works for any brand that wants merch with a point of view.

Creatives conference merch

Activation: We Are Made for Impact

A conference for creatives needed a shirt that said one thing: creatives make more impact when they are switched on. I turned the word Activation into the design itself, with a cursor clicking the final letters, and built it in a glowing, digital style that prints well on dark fabric.

2 drafts10 colourways tested25K naira pre-order
How it came together
  1. Explored two directions. A copper 3D type draft and a cooler glowing one.
  2. Team selected the glowing draft. It read as digital and creative.
  3. Tested ten colours. Black, navy, off-white and wine went forward.
  4. Launched pre-orders. Poster with price and a one-tap WhatsApp order route.
  5. Worn at the event. Attendees wore it through the day and in group photos.
Get merch like this
Week-long event merch

The Emergence of Sons

A full merch range for the closing event of a leadership tenure, worn on a set day during the week. I led it from mood board to delivery, balancing a bold concept with sponsor and elder feedback for a simpler look.

Tees, caps, totes and more4 drafts presentedJul 12 to Aug 19
Project timeline
  1. Jul 12. Brainstorming and mood board.
  2. Jul 26 to 28. Sketches moved to the digital artboard. First draft approved after minor revisions, and the tenure slogan added at the C-Board's request.
  3. Aug 5. First full set across totes, tees, sweatshirts and caps. Sponsors asked for a more minimal look.
  4. Aug 9. Four drafts presented so the team could choose quickly.
  5. Aug 16. Pre-order graphics for tees and sweatshirts published.
  6. Aug 18. Full range delivered: totes, journals, caps, hoodies, tees and sweatshirts, with mockups and print files. Publicity started Aug 19.
